title: Ya Hussian Ya Hussian Marhaba Ya Hussian
body:
Ya Hussian Ya Hussian Marhaba Ya Hussian
Ya Ali Ya Hassan Fatima Ya Hussain
Nusrat-e-haq Me Tu Ghar Luta Ya Hussian
Deen Ne Haq Ke Liye Sar Kata Ya Hussian
<<DIVIDER>>
Mahenate Ambiya Ki Baqa Ya Hussian
Kahete Hai Ambiya Marhaba YaHussian
Vaar Jab Bhi Kiya Padke Nade Ali
Mangi Tuj Se Panha Darke Fouj-e-Shaqi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha Ibadat Me Tu Jab Shahdat Huwi
Uff Wo Sajda Tera Marhaba Ya Hussian
Qalb Tukde Huwa Ibne Shabbir Nahi
Hai Nazar Me Duha Hae Akbar Nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham Se Toti Kamar Wo Baradar Nahi
Sabr Ki Inteha Marhaba Ya Hussian
Ran Me Ghode Se Tu Jab Zami Par Gira
Koi Mohnis Na Tha Ibne Hiader Tera
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Ki Godi Me Tha Shahedi Sar Tera
Kehti Hai Fatima Marhaba Ya Hussian
Ta Qayamat Tera Gham Manaenge hum
Karke Sina Zani Khoon Bhaenge Hum
<<DIVIDER>>
Roze Mahsar Sila Iska Paenge Hum
Nouha Mazhar Tera Marhaba Ya Hussian
